wizard.title: Import {{entity}}
wizard.subtitle: Bring your existing records into iCASCO: download the template, fill it, upload it and review before anything is saved.

template.title: A template made for {{entity}}
template.body: Fill one record per row, starting under the grey example row. Keep the two header rows; you may move or hide columns.
template.requiredHint: Rows without these are not imported.
template.laterHint: Rows without these are imported and listed as records to complete.
template.formats: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD · phone numbers with the country code · several values separated by commas · allowed values on the Lists sheet

upload.title: Upload your filled file
upload.formats: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV, up to {{size}} MB
upload.readingHint: iCASCO checks every row; nothing is saved yet.

errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 10 MB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.FILE_TYPE: Upload an Excel file (.xlsx, .xls) or a CSV file.
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read. Save it again as .xlsx and retry.
errors.NO_COLUMNS: No template columns were found. Use the template downloaded from this screen.
errors.WRONG_TEMPLATE: This file is the template of another area. Download the template from this screen.
errors.XLS_NOT_SUPPORTED: The preview reads .xlsx and .csv files. Save the file as .xlsx and upload it again.
errors.generic: The file could not be checked. Try again.

review.completenessHint: Share of the template fields your file fills. Required fields count double.

statusHint.duplicate: Already in iCASCO: update or skip

review.columnsMissing: Columns not found in your file: {{columns}}
review.noRows: The file has no rows to import. Fill the rows under the example row and upload it again.
review.downloadIssuesHint: The file lists each row with an Issues column. Fix it and upload it again.
review.oldTemplate: This file was made with template {{version}}. It was read; download the new template next time.
review.notTemplate: This file is not an iCASCO template; its columns were matched by their names.

import.title: Choose what to import
import.completeOnlyHint: {{count}} ready rows. Partial rows wait until you fix them in the file.
import.includePartialHint: {{count}} rows. Partial rows are created and listed as records to complete.
import.skipHint: Existing records stay exactly as they are.
import.update: Update them with the values in the file
import.updateHint: Filled cells replace the stored values; empty cells change nothing.
import.nothing: There is nothing to import with this choice.
import.invalidNote: Invalid rows are never imported: {{count}}. Download them, fix them and upload them again.
import.failed: The import could not be completed. Nothing was saved; try again.
import.welcomeEmails: Send the portal welcome e-mail to each new client
import.welcomeEmailsHint: The primary contact e-mail becomes the client's portal login.

result.title: Import finished
result.subtitle: {{file}} · {{entity}}
result.completeHint: Each link opens the record with the missing field selected. Save it, then use the Back button to return here.

hub.dismissHint: Remove this record from the list without completing it.
hub.title: Data migration
hub.subtitle: Move the records of your previous system into iCASCO, one template at a time. Nothing is saved before you review it, and existing records change only when you choose.
hub.progressHint: Areas imported: {{done}} of {{total}} · records to complete: {{open}}

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Download the template of an area. Each template has instructions and dropdown lists.
how.step2: Fill it offline with your records, one per row.
how.step3: Upload it: iCASCO shows what it understood, the completeness of each row and what is missing.
how.step4: Import the usable rows, then complete the remaining records from the list below.

hub.orderHint: Each step uses the records of the earlier ones: clients before their sites and contacts, certificates before their cycles.
hub.toCompleteHint: Imported without a field that is needed later. Open a record, fill the highlighted field and save; it leaves this list.
hub.toCompleteEmpty: Nothing to complete. Records imported without a needed field appear here.
hub.loadError: The migration status could not be loaded.
